app.name: Infodock
notify.configRestored.backup: Your settings could not be read, so the last good copy was restored. The unreadable file is kept as {file}.
notify.configRestored.defaults: Your settings could not be read, so Infodock started with its default settings. The unreadable file is kept as {file}.
settings.title: Infodock Settings
settings.nav.label: Settings pages
settings.general.hotkey.help: Works from any app. Select the button, then press the new combination; Esc cancels.
settings.general.hotkey.error: This hotkey could not be registered: {error}
settings.general.hotkey.taken: Another app already uses {hotkey}. Choose a different combination.
settings.general.hotkey.needsModifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Win with the key. Only function keys work on their own.
settings.general.hotkey.unsupported: {key} cannot be used in a hotkey.
settings.general.hotkey.unavailable: Global hotkeys are not available on this system.
settings.general.hotkeyAction.bringToFro: Bring the bar to the front
settings.general.newSensorMenu.help: A list of the sensor types adds the chosen one at once.
settings.bar.monitor.missing: {name} (not connected; the primary monitor is used)
settings.bar.mode.help: Drag a floating bar by its background while it is unlocked.
settings.bar.reserveSpace.help: Maximised windows stop at the bar, as they do at the taskbar.
settings.bar.zOrder.help: With “Always behind”, the hotkey brings the bar forward until you click elsewhere.
settings.bar.highlightOnHover.help: The bar becomes more opaque while the pointer is over it.
settings.bar.animations.help: The bar sliding in, fades and highlights.
sensor.placeholder.unknown: This sensor ({type}) is not available in this version of Infodock.
sensor.field.shadow.help: A one-pixel shadow that contrasts with the text colour.
sensor.text.name: Text
sensor.text.description: A line of text of your choice.
sensor.image.name: Image
sensor.image.description: A picture, or the Infodock logo.
sensor.image.field.image.help: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO or SVG. Leave empty for the Infodock logo.
sensor.image.field.color.help: A custom colour tints the image.
sensor.image.field.popupText.help: Shown on hover; %v is replaced by the Infodock version.
sensor.cpu.label: CPU
sensor.cpu.series.missing: Processor {n} (not on this computer: shows the total)
sensor.cpuDual.name: CPU Graph (dual)
sensor.cpuDual.description: Two processors, or total and user time, as graphs above and below each other.
sensor.cpuDual.singleProcessor: This computer has one processor; both halves show the same data.
sensor.dual.field.flipBottom.help: The bottom graph grows down from the middle; off, it grows up from the bottom edge.
sensor.cpuMeter.name: CPU Meter
sensor.cpuMeter.description: How busy the processors are, as a meter.
sensor.cpuGraph.name: CPU Graph
sensor.cpuGraph.description: How busy the processors are, as a graph over time.
sensor.memory.label: RAM
sensor.memoryMeter.name: Memory Meter
sensor.memoryMeter.description: How much of the memory (RAM) is in use, as a meter.
sensor.memoryGraph.name: Memory Graph
sensor.memoryGraph.description: How much of the memory (RAM) is in use, as a graph over time.
sensor.swap.label: Swap
sensor.swapMeter.name: Swap Meter
sensor.swapMeter.description: How much of the page file is in use, as a meter.
sensor.swapGraph.name: Swap Graph
sensor.swapGraph.description: How much of the page file is in use, as a graph over time.
sensor.diskMeter.name: Disk Meter
sensor.diskMeter.description: How full a drive is, as a meter.
sensor.disk.label: HD: {drive}
sensor.disk.field.title: Title
sensor.disk.field.title.help: Leave empty for HD: and the drive, e.g. HD: C:\.
sensor.disk.hint.title: Disk Meter for {drive}
sensor.networkGraph.name: Network Graph
sensor.networkGraph.description: What a network connection receives and sends, as graphs above and below each other.
sensor.network.field.adapter.help: Automatic follows the connection to the internet.
sensor.network.field.bandwidth.help: Bytes per second for a full graph, as receive,send or one value for both (e.g. 12500000 for 100 Mbit/s). Empty: scale to the traffic.
sensor.network.field.flipBottom.help: The send graph grows down from the middle; off, it grows up from the bottom edge.
sensor.date.name: Date
sensor.date.description: Today's date, with a month calendar when you point at it.
sensor.date.field.calendar.help: The calendar shown when you point at the date, and its first day of the week.
sensor.time.name: Time
sensor.time.description: The current time, with seconds and a chime if you like.
sensor.uptime.name: Uptime
sensor.uptime.description: How long the computer has been running, and its longest run.
sensor.uptime.field.text.help: Shown before the uptime; leave empty for none.
sensor.shortcut.name: Shortcut
sensor.shortcut.description: Opens a program, document, folder or web address.
sensor.shortcut.field.target.help: The program, document or folder to open.
sensor.shortcut.field.args.help: Passed to the program as they are.
sensor.shortcut.field.url.help: Opened instead of the target: http://, https://, ftp:// or another address such as ms-settings: or mailto:.
sensor.shortcut.field.workDir.help: Leave empty for the target's folder.
sensor.shortcut.field.title: Title
sensor.shortcut.field.title.help: Shown on hover. Leave empty for the name of the file, folder or web address.
sensor.shortcut.field.image.help: ICO, PNG, GIF, JPEG or SVG. Leave empty for the target's icon.
sensor.shortcut.field.color.help: A custom colour tints the icon.
sensor.diskLauncher.name: Disk
sensor.diskLauncher.description: Opens a drive, and ejects a USB drive or a disc.
sensor.diskLauncher.field.title: Title
sensor.diskLauncher.field.title.help: Shown on hover. Leave empty for the drive's name, e.g. Local Disk (C:).
sensor.diskLauncher.field.image.help: ICO, PNG, GIF, JPEG or SVG. Leave empty for the drive's icon.
eject.inUseBy: {name} is in use by {app}. Close it and try again.
eject.inUse: {name} is in use. Close the files and programs that use it and try again.
sensor.wifi.name: Wi-Fi Signal
sensor.wifi.description: The Wi-Fi network and its signal strength.
sensor.wifi.field.title: Title
sensor.wifi.field.title.help: Leave empty for the network name.
sensor.wifi.display.name: Network name
sensor.wifi.hint.title: Wi-Fi Signal
sensor.wifi.hint.location: Allow location access to show the network name
sensor.wifi.hint.click: Click to open the Wi-Fi settings
sensor.wifi.hint.clickLocation: Click to open the location settings
sensor.recycleBin.name: Recycle Bin
sensor.recycleBin.description: What the Recycle Bin holds; opens and empties it.
sensor.recycleBin.field.title: Title
sensor.recycleBin.field.image.help: ICO, PNG, GIF, JPEG or SVG. Leave empty for the built-in icon.
sensor.recycleBin.title: Recycle Bin
sensor.recycleBin.hint.click: Click to open the Recycle Bin
sensor.battery.name: Battery
sensor.battery.description: The battery's charge and time left, and an alert when it has charged enough.
sensor.battery.field.show.help: A click on the sensor switches between the two.
sensor.battery.field.smoothTimeToEmpty.h: Averages the battery's estimate, which jumps with the load.
sensor.battery.field.timeToFullSource.he: Some batteries report no time until full, or an unsteady one.
sensor.battery.timeToFull.calculated: Calculated from the charging so far
sensor.battery.field.assumeChargedAt.hel: For batteries that stop charging early, e.g. with a charge limit.
sensor.battery.field.alertAbove.help: A notification once per charge, when the charge passes this level.
sensor.battery.alert: Battery at {percent} — you can unplug the charger
sensor.folderMenu.name: Folder Menu
sensor.folderMenu.description: Opens the files and folders of a folder from a list.
sensor.folderMenu.field.title: Title
sensor.folderMenu.field.title.help: Shown on hover and above the list. Leave empty for the folder's name.
sensor.folderMenu.field.image.help: ICO, PNG, GIF, JPEG or SVG. Leave empty for the folder icon.
sensor.folderMenu.field.showHidden.help: Also lists hidden and system files and folders.
sensor.startMenu.name: Start Menu
sensor.startMenu.description: Opens the programs of the Start Menu from a list.
sensor.startMenu.field.title.help: Shown on hover and above the list. Leave empty for "Start Menu".
sensor.startMenu.field.image.help: ICO, PNG, GIF, JPEG or SVG. Leave empty for the Start Menu icon.
sensor.ejectUsb.name: Eject USB
sensor.ejectUsb.description: Lists the USB drives and discs that can be ejected, and ejects them.
sensor.power.name: Power
sensor.power.description: Locks, signs out, sleeps, shuts down or restarts the computer.
sensor.power.field.confirm.help: Asks before acting, so a stray click does nothing.
sensor.power.field.force.help: Unsaved work in open apps is lost.
sensor.power.unavailable: {mode} is not available on this computer
sensor.power.confirm.lock: Do you really want to lock this computer?
sensor.power.confirm.signOut: Do you really want to sign out of this computer?
sensor.power.confirm.switchUser: Do you really want to switch user on this computer?
sensor.power.confirm.sleep: Do you really want to put this computer to sleep?
sensor.power.confirm.hibernate: Do you really want to hibernate this computer?
sensor.power.confirm.shutDown: Do you really want to shut down this computer?
sensor.power.confirm.restart: Do you really want to restart this computer?
sensor.spacer.name: Spacer
sensor.spacer.description: Empty space between sensors, with an optional divider line.
settings.color.invalid: Enter a colour as #RRGGBB, for example #1C1C1F.
settings.sensors.defaults.help: For every sensor that does not set its own.
settings.sensors.textColor.help: For every label, and for icons in standard colour mode.
settings.sensors.inactiveMode.help: How the icon of a sensor with nothing to show is drawn, such as an absent drive or a disconnected Wi-Fi.
settings.popups.strongTextColor.help: For weekends in the calendar and other highlights.
settings.props.title: {name} properties
settings.props.noFields: This sensor has no properties to change.
settings.layout.title: Layout
settings.layout.help: The sensors on the bar, zone by zone from left to right. Drag a sensor, or use its arrow buttons, to move it.
settings.picker.title: New sensor
settings.appearance.theme.help: Classic is a compact bar drawn with a skin.
settings.appearance.colorScheme.help: Light or dark, for Settings and the modern bar.
settings.appearance.colorMode.classicHel: Built-in skins are drawn in this colour. Skin packs and the custom image keep their own colours until you set one, which tints them.
settings.appearance.opacity.classicHelp: The theme default is {value} %. It applies to the skin, not to the sensors.
settings.appearance.material.help: Acrylic and Mica let the desktop show through the bar, blurred.
settings.appearance.material.off: Turn on Transparency effects in Windows Settings ▸ Personalisation ▸ Colours to use a material.
settings.appearance.skin.missing: The skin “{name}” is not installed on this computer, so Gloss is used.
settings.appearance.skin.unusable: The skin “{name}” cannot be used, so Gloss is used: {reason}
settings.appearance.customSkin.help: A PNG or JPEG image of at most 512 × 512 px and 1 MB, repeated across the bar. Without one the bar is Flat.
settings.appearance.packs.help: Packs are folders in the skins folder. Install one from its folder or from a .zip file holding it; Remove moves it to the Recycle Bin.
settings.appearance.packs.installFailed: The skin pack could not be installed: {reason}
skins.install.notAPack: There is no skin.json in it (in a .zip, at its top or in one folder).
skins.install.name: “{name}” cannot be the name of a skin pack. Rename the folder or file.
skins.install.zipInvalid: It is not a zip file, or it is damaged.
skins.install.zipUnsupported: The zip file is encrypted, larger than 4 GB or compressed in a way Infodock cannot read.
skins.install.tooLarge: The zip file is larger than 32 MB.
skins.error.reserved: The folder has the name of a built-in skin. Rename the folder.
skins.error.noImage: skin.json names no image for one of the screen edges.
skins.error.height: The height and shadow band together must be 1–512 px.
skins.error.fileName: “{file}” is not the name of a file in the skin's folder.
skins.error.format: “{file}” is not a PNG or JPEG image.
skins.error.tileHeight: “{file}” is {actual} px tall; the skin's height and shadow band need {expected} px.
import.warning.invalidValue: {sensor}: the value of “{key}” cannot be used, so its default is used instead.
import.warning.unknownType: “{type}” is not a sensor type of this version of Infodock. It is kept and shown as a placeholder.
import.error.io: The file could not be read: {error}
import.error.tooLarge: The file is too large to be a layout.
import.error.notALayout: The file does not hold an Infodock layout.
import.error.newer: The file was saved by a newer version of Infodock. Update Infodock to import it.
